in both columns when empty. Computed WCAG contrast ratio #A0A3BD on white = 2.48:1. WCAG 2.1 AA requires ≥4.5:1 for normal text (28px regular ≠ 'large' per WCAG definition of 18pt regular / 14pt bold). FAILS WCAG AA.
findings.fix_hint: Darken placeholder color to at least #6B6F8C (ratio 4.6:1 on white) or use #4F5469 (ratio 7.2:1). File: resources/js/components/admin/customer-screen/OrderStatusScreenComponent.vue or equivalent (locate by class oss-column-header data-v-3aa5d0ca).

findings.evidence: Empty 'En préparation' column (and both columns in state 05) show ONLY a single em-dash '—' as placeholder. No illustration (), no copy ≥20 chars, no primary CTA. This directly contradicts the owner mandate 'readable from 3 m' — a tiny 28px gray dash on a TV screen is invisible from distance. Customer cannot tell whether the screen is empty (no orders), waiting to load, or broken.
findings.fix_hint: Replace em-dash with an explicit visible message: 'En attente…' / 'Aucune commande en cours.' rendered at ≥40px in same brand-neutral dark color (text-[#1F1F39]). Consider adding a static SVG illustration (clock or kitchen icon) at 200×200px above the message. Files to look at: OrderStatusScreenComponent.vue empty branch (v-if="!orders.length" inside the <ul> grandchild).

findings.evidence: Both OSS columns are dynamic containers (orders enter via realtime, leave on pickup) yet DOM has zero aria-live / role=status anywhere on the page. role=region + aria-label='En préparation'/'Prêt' are present on the column wrappers (good) but the <ul class='oss-order-list'> children that change live are not announced. A blind operator/customer using a screen reader on the OSS-as-status-display path is not notified when 'N°A0001' transitions from En préparation to Prêt.
findings.fix_hint: Add aria-live='polite' aria-atomic='false' role='status' on each <ul class='oss-order-list'>. Also consider aria-relevant='additions removals'. Files: OrderStatusScreenComponent.vue lines containing class='oss-order-list'.

findings.evidence: The OSS view shows the full admin top-bar chrome (FoodKing logo, Filiale dropdown 'Le Cayenne (principal)', 'Tableau De Bord' button, 'Bonjour Admin Le Cayenne' personal greeting) above the two columns. The admin sidebar is correctly hidden (db-sidebar hidden) but the top header consumes ~60–80 px at the top of the screen — visible to customers waiting in the restaurant. The greeting 'Bonjour Admin Le Cayenne' is a minor privacy leak (operator identity exposed) and the chrome competes with the brand red/green columns for attention. Note: the body container intentionally compensates with h-[calc(100dvh-117px)], so this is by design, not a layout bug — but it remains a UX smell on a customer-facing TV.
findings.fix_hint: Provide a dedicated 'TV mode' route (?tv=1 or /customer-screen?fullscreen) that hides the admin top header. Acceptable alternative: keep the FoodKing branding strip but suppress the personal greeting + Tableau-de-bord button when ?tv=1 is set.

findings.evidence: Console emits ~30 'level=warning' entries: '[intlify] Not found menu.communications / menu.users / menu.accounts / menu.reports / menu.setup key in fr locale messages'. These keys ARE present in DOM but the parent <aside class='db-sidebar hidden'> hides them (display:none via Tailwind 'hidden'). They are therefore not user-visible on the OSS surface — reviewer protocol category 1 (i18n leak) is for VISIBLE text only, so this is downgraded to P3 informational. Still: the underlying admin sidebar i18n debt should be flagged for the next admin-i18n sweep — these will leak the moment the sidebar is unhidden.
findings.fix_hint: Add missing keys to resources/lang/fr/menu.php (communications, users, accounts, reports, setup) or to the appropriate vue-i18n bundle. Out of scope for OSS Wave C — pre-existing admin debt.
